courses.title: Life and Legacy of Martin Harris
courses.description: A comprehensive study of Martin Harris's life, witness testimony, and movement between different restoration traditions. This course takes a scholarly, non-apologetic approach from a Community of Christ perspective.

courses.title: Joseph Smith Jr.: Prophet, Translator, and Visionary
courses.description: A comprehensive, scholarly examination of Joseph Smith Jr.'s life, revelations, and legacy across multiple restoration traditions. This course takes a Community of Christ approach: honest, non-apologetic, and open to complexity.

courses.title: The Reorganization and Community of Christ
courses.description: A comprehensive study of the Reorganized Church of Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saints (RLDS) and its evolution into Community of Christ. This course examines theological distinctives, historical developments, and the progressive journey from restoration movement to peace and justice church.

courses.title: The Concept of Zion in Restoration Theology
courses.description: A comprehensive exploration of how Zion—as theological concept, social vision, economic system, and geographic place—has been understood across restoration traditions. This course examines biblical foundations, Joseph Smith's innovations, and contemporary interpretations from a Community of Christ scholarly perspective.

restoration-history.name: Restoration History
restoration-history.description: Study the history of the restoration movement from its origins through diverse contemporary expressions

community-of-christ.name: Community of Christ Journey
community-of-christ.description: Explore the unique theological and historical path of Community of Christ

restoration-theology.name: Restoration Theology
restoration-theology.description: Deep dive into key theological concepts across restoration traditions

metadata.approach: Community of Christ - scholarly, non-apologetic, honest inquiry
